expects.reason: MiniCover 3.10.0 supports the .NET 8 SDK this branch uses (net10.0;net9.0;net8.0), so the target framework does not exclude it. It instruments a build and runs the test suite, and OrderKit.sln does not compile on this branch: its projects ship Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs files that duplicate the SDK-generated assembly attributes (CS0579), and OrderKit.Tests and OrderKit.Contracts reference ..\..\OrderKit.* projects that do not exist.

data.note: The C# core of this folder's fixtures is C# 5-compatible, so it is identical on all 13 families and what the tool measures cannot drift between them. The LanguageMarker class in each file is what pins the file to C# 12.0; it does not compile under C# 11.0. No project manifest is present, by design.
